evidence.excerpt: The restaurant-controlled location page identifies CIRCA at Navy Yard at 99 M Street SE Ste 100, Washington, DC 20003 and exposes location-specific lunch, dinner, brunch, dessert, happy-hour, zero-proof, nonalcoholic-beer, and online-order surfaces. Navigation separately identifies Clarendon, Foggy Bottom, Navy Yard, and The Boro.

The restaurant-issued DC Spring 2026 lunch PDF enumerates the complete Navy Yard lunch food surface with item descriptions and dietary icons. Visual inspection retained direct shellfish/nut icons on their own items and kept the gluten-environment warning separate.
The restaurant-issued DC Winter 2026 dinner PDF enumerates the complete Navy Yard dinner food surface. Visual inspection prevented adjacent icons and optional proteins from bleeding between items.
The restaurant-issued DC Spring 2026 brunch PDF enumerates the complete Navy Yard brunch food, side, salad, sandwich, and flatbread surface with literal ingredient descriptions and item-level icons.
The restaurant-controlled ordering hub links Navy Yard to ChowNow location 34564 and keeps the other CIRCA locations on separate links.

The linked live ChowNow storefront identifies Circa at Navy Yard at 99 M St SE and exposes 45 unique food products after duplicate popular cards and an alcoholic cocktail are excluded. It adds Crispy Brussels + Blue to the union and directly names blue cheese, but provides no comprehensive allergen matrix.
The restaurant-issued Navy Yard Spring 2026 beverage PDF lists the current zero-proof cocktails and nonalcoholic beers. Alcoholic products were excluded from the POC boundary.

The official Navy Yard party catalog says gluten-sensitive options are available, CIRCA is not a gluten-free environment, and dietary restrictions should be disclosed before menu selection. This is restaurant-level context, not an item matrix.
